Add the bus tool: lay a bundle of wires between pin groups

Joining 8 pins to 8 pins took 8 wires by hand. The bus tool (B) takes
the pins inside a frame - or a whole IC group like A[0..3] on a click -
then as many target pins, and lays one wire per pair: each beside the
one before, same shape one step aside, leaving pins straight out of
their parts. Both orders are tried and the one with fewer crossings
wins. The wires share a bundle number (saved), and dragging a piece of
one moves the matching piece of the others, so the bus keeps its
spacing.
